Every module compiled here is I/O-free: `lib/assessment-grading.ts` imports two type-only modules and nothing else; `lib/assessment-verification.ts` adds `lib/study-session.ts`, which imports nothing at all; `lib/assessment-revocation.ts` is types-only; `lib/assessment-mistakes.ts` adds `lib/occurrences.ts` (pure builders over injected verbs) and `lib/sha256.ts`. That is what makes 'the occurrence exists before the next question renders' and 'a coverage hole refuses to verify' provable with no Supabase project and no API key in reach (U.3, the determinism boundary).
